newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to meet Russian Interior Minister Kulikov.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to meet Russian Interior Minister Kulikov.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will go to the Kremlin on Thursday to meet Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov, the presidential press office said.
Yeltsin, 66, has been recovering from pneumonia at a residence outside Moscow and doctors say he needs at least another 10 days to shake off the illness.
He has held some meetings in the Kremlin and several in the secluded Gorky-9 residence where he has been staying since he left hospital on January 20.
Yeltsin appointed Kulikov a deputy prime minister on Monday, giving him responsibility for coordinating the fight against organised crime and control of tax police operations.
The Kremlin said the two topics would be on the agenda at the meeting between Yeltsin and Kulikov. The meeting would take place at noon (0900 GMT).
The two men could also discuss the situation in the former Soviet republic of Tajikistan, where an armed group is holding more than a dozen hostages, including Russian reporters.
